narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed along a slow moving sea breeze boundary across central Androscoggin County on the afternoon into early evening of the 25th. The storm produced rainfall rates between 2 and 3 inches an hour on top of already saturated soils. This ended up leading to multiple instances of flash flooding, specifically in the Cities of Auburn and Lewiston. In addition to the more significant flash flooding, trees were reported down in numerous locations due to convective outflow winds.
ev: Heavy rain reported at 3 to 5 inches fell across the Lewiston/Auburn area during the early evening hours of the 25th. This nearly stationary storm caused major disruptions to the evening commute as a number of primary thruways were closed. The flooding started in Lewiston when North Temple Road closed, followed shortly by Main Street. Cars stalled and were submerged in the floodwaters. As the event unfolded the flooding extended to southern Lewiston over Adams Avenue near the Public Works Department, and flooded parking lots at Bates College.
